title: New Undercounter Basins! A Deeper Offering..
bodyHtml:
Ovale Undercounter - 550 x 380 x 185 mm

A definitive new range of Under Counter Basins

Our new Undercounter Basin range expands with a deeper and more versatile offering—crafted to suit the diverse demands of contemporary bathrooms.

This updated selection brings a stronger focus on subtle design, intelligent function, and architectural compatibility.


Cubic 80 Undercounter Basin - 840 x 455 x 155 mm

A Broader Range of Solutions

The new collection introduces a host of models featuring integrated overflow, reversible overflow positioning and innovative Hidden Syphonic Overflow technology—delivering a minimalist aesthetic without compromising drainage performance.

A swathe of new slimmer options with shortened depths have also been introduced to optimise space without sacrificing comfort or usability, making these basins ideal for compact bathroom spaces.


Happy Hour Oval 57 - 570 x 380 x 150 mm

Italian Craft, Universal Appeal

New to the range, the Happy Hour Undercounter series brings Italian artistry to the fore.

Made in Italy, these expressive forms are available in a suite of premium colour finishes and are designed to complement a wide range of interior styles and vanity configurations.


Fall 60 V2 - 600 x 370 x 180 mm

Fall V2: Now with Overflow

The next iteration of our much-loved Fall Series brings its signature softness and sculpted geometry into a more technically capable format.

Now available with overflow, Fall V2 answers the need for compliant, design-conscious solutions across both residential and commercial applications.
